prompt: Create one complete horizontal 16:9 medieval leaded STAINED-GLASS artwork, one coherent scene. The ENTIRE image must be made of translucent colored glass pieces separated by clearly visible dark lead cames: faces, hands, robes, objects, terrain and sky. Lead seams cross inside faces along forehead, brows, nose bridge, cheekbones and jaw; 10-16 facial panes, not smooth painted skin inside a stained-glass border. Believable natural anatomy and subtle expression, not cartoon, not photorealistic painting. Jewel-toned handmade glass, uneven texture, directional transmitted light with readable shadows. Environment and figures one continuous perspective, no comic panels or webpage cards. Keep key faces, hands and props within central 80% of image. No text, no lettering, no readable runes, no watermark, no logos, no crosses or unrelated religious imagery.  Theme subtitle for semantic guidance ONLY, do not draw words: 承认可能的自己，承担未完的选择. Single moment after Chi-Ji has healed Jaina: tired Thrall and Jaina gently shake hands, cautiously reconnecting. Close composition on two faces and hands: adult green orc with blue eyes, black braids, simple brown robe sleeve, and white-haired human woman with a golden-blonde hair streak, modest pale blue-white clothing. Both look exhausted but attentive, no beaming celebration. Minimal quiet Pandaren courtyard background with no prominent architecture. No healing spell emitted by Thrall, no magical beam, no weapons, no throne or coronation, no duplicate selves. Soft pale amber returning to cool blue-green glass, hope that remains modest.

subtitle.text: 承认可能的自己，承担未完的选择
